project_name: Suvi Interior - Premium Header, Wordmark & Footer System

components_to_update.role: Responsive architectural brand mark replacing lowercase suvi. with proper smallcaps/caps and brass descriptor
components_to_update.instructions: Implement responsive SUVI INTERIOR mark. Render SUVI in Cormorant Garamond (uppercase/small-caps), accompanied by refined diamond/hairline divider and INTERIOR in Plus Jakarta Sans tracking-[0.24em]. Support compact (mobile) and standard (desktop/tablet) responsive layouts.

components_to_update.role: Architectural glassmorphic header matching living room hero photography
components_to_update.instructions: Eliminate solid harsh #58130E red band. Use dual-state dynamic background: top state uses translucent charcoal/oxblood veil (rgba(20, 18, 16, 0.72) with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px white/10 border) that blends with the walnut & brass hero photo; scrolled state (>30px) transitions smoothly to rich blurred oxblood-deep with refined brass bottom hairline. Include responsive navigation links, phone contact badge, CTA button, and accessible mobile menu button with required data-testids.

components_to_update.role: Editorial 4-column atelier footer with monumental brand signature
components_to_update.instructions: Replace cramped footer with 4-column architectural layout: 1) Studio colophon with wordmark, vision, direct WhatsApp & phone CTAs; 2) Navigation & interior services list; 3) Studio address, showroom details and Google directions link; 4) Direct brochure PDF card. Feature fluid monumental SUVI INTERIOR signature banner with brass tint and bottom copyright/legal bar.

components_to_update.role: CSS refinements for header, wordmark, and footer
components_to_update.instructions: Update .atelier-header to remove harsh solid block and apply smooth glass transition. Replace .studio-wordmark styles to support the new elegant typography hierarchy and ensure proper print/mobile responsiveness.

technical_invariants.opacity_gates: NEVER reintroduce page-wide opacity gates or route delay animations. .page-content must remain opacity: 1 and visibility: visible at all times.
technical_invariants.direct_pdf_downloads: Retain all direct PDF download links for brochure and catalog.
technical_invariants.data_testids: All interactive triggers, logo links, nav items, and footer actions must retain or include specified data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.design_philosophy: Precision architectural atelier, warm luxury, restraint and clarity over decorative noise.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.color_contrast: Ensure all text on header and footer meets WCAG AA standards against translucent dark backdrops with minimum 4.5:1 contrast.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.motion_strategy: Micro-interactions only: subtle transform hover on links, smooth backdrop transitions on scroll, staggered items in mobile drawer.
